text:
```yaml
name: Go Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  go-test:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v2
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: go mod tidy

    - name: Run tests
      run: go test ./...
```
